title: WCL Mining Sirdar Mock Test 03
subtitle: Western Coalfields Limited — Mining Sirdar Recruitment
instructions: Select the best answer for each question

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'fire water pump' capacity in mines must be
options: The same as a domestic water pump
Sufficient to supply fire points at required pressure
Not related to the number of fire points
questions.solution: Fire pumps must supply adequate pressure to fire points.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'safety factor' of a winding rope for persons is the ratio of
options: Maximum working load to breaking load
Breaking load to the maximum working load
Depth of shaft to rope diameter
questions.solution: Breaking load to maximum working load.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A self-rescuer is used to
options: Provide breathing apparatus in case of mine fire or gas inrush
questions.solution: Provides breathing apparatus in emergency situations.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'stage loader' at a longwall face transfers coal from
options: The AFC to the belt conveyor at the gate end
The face to the AFC at the tailgate
The belt conveyor to the surface
The gate end to the face
questions.solution: From AFC to belt conveyor at gate end.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'isolation stopping' in mine fires is used to
options: Seal off fire-affected area from rest of mine
questions.solution: Isolation stoppings seal off fire-affected areas.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'intake air' in a mine ventilation system refers to
options: Fresh air entering the mine from the surface
questions.solution: Fresh air entering the mine from the surface.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'blast hole diameter' selection depends on
options: Rock type, explosive type, and fragmentation requirements
questions.solution: Hole diameter depends on geology, explosive, and fragmentation.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A person who has been employed as a sirdar must
options: Hold a valid competency certificate as prescribed
questions.solution: A sirdar must hold a valid competency certificate.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'bord and pillar' panel typically has pillars of
options: A fixed size of 20 m square
The size of the longest gallery
A size equal to the haul road width
Designed size based on depth and seam thickness
questions.solution: Designed size based on depth and seam thickness.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The electrical cables in mines must be
options: Protected from mechanical damage and moisture
questions.solution: Protected from mechanical damage and moisture.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under the Mines Act, a 'mine' includes
options: Only the buildings on the surface
Only the persons employed in the mine
All works, machinery, and equipment used in connection with mining
questions.solution: All works, machinery, and equipment used in connection with mining.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A preventive maintenance schedule for face machineries includes
options: Regular inspection, lubrication, and replacement of worn parts
Replacement of the machine after every shift
Painting the machine once a year
questions.solution: Regular inspection, lubrication, and replacement of worn parts.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The minimum width of a man riding seat on a rope haulage system is
questions.solution: The minimum width is 300 mm.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'rescue equipment inspection' should be
options: Before each use and at regular intervals
Only when the equipment is new
questions.solution: Rescue equipment must be inspected before each use.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The maximum speed of a man riding locomotive underground is
questions.solution: The maximum speed is 5 m/s.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A man riding system operating in a shaft must have a
questions.solution: A device to prevent overwinding is required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'auxiliary fan' in underground mines is used to
options: Supplement main ventilation for specific areas
questions.solution: Auxiliary fans supplement main ventilation for specific areas.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'room' in room and pillar mining refers to
questions.solution: Room is the excavated area between pillars.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'handover report' between shifts should include
options: Only the number of persons employed
Only the quantity of coal produced
Only the names of the officials
Safety conditions, pending work, and outstanding issues
questions.solution: Safety conditions, pending work, and outstanding issues.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017, the manager must ensure that man riding systems
options: Are maintained in safe working condition
Are used only during day shift
questions.solution: Systems must be maintained in safe working condition.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: In opencast coal mines, deep hole blasting uses holes of depth
questions.solution: Deep hole blasting uses 5-15 meter holes for overburden and coal.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The capacity of a dragline is measured in
questions.solution: Measured in cubic meters of bucket capacity.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'pack wall' in stowing is used to
options: Support the roof over the pack
Separate the goaf from the working
Retain stowing material in the goaf
questions.solution: Retains stowing material in the goaf.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'stowing operations plan' must include
options: Only the quantity of coal production
Material source, transport method, dam design, and monitoring
Only the number of workers engaged
questions.solution: Operations plan must cover material, transport, dams, and monitoring.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The moisture content of coal dust affects
options: Its explosibility - higher moisture reduces explosibility
questions.solution: Higher moisture reduces explosibility.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'personal dust sampler' is worn by
options: Individual workers to measure personal exposure
questions.solution: Personal dust samplers are worn by workers to measure exposure.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017, the 'means of communication' in a mine must include
options: Telephone, signaling system, or other approved means
A public address system on the surface only
questions.solution: Telephone, signaling system, or other approved means.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The earthing resistance of electrical equipment in mines must be
options: Exactly equal to the supply voltage
Low enough to ensure protective device operates in time
questions.solution: Low enough to ensure protective device operates in time.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: An explosion-proof motor in a mine is designed to
options: Operate safely in hazardous atmosphere without igniting gas or dust
questions.solution: Operates safely without igniting gas or dust.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'time factor' in report writing is important because
options: Delays can compromise the effectiveness of corrective actions
Reports can be written after a month
The length of the report matters
questions.solution: Delays can compromise the effectiveness of corrective actions.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'safety officer' in a mine must be appointed as per
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Regulation 39.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'underground control survey' must be connected to
options: The surface control survey at regular intervals
A point chosen by the overman
The national grid only on request
questions.solution: Connected to surface control survey at regular intervals.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'rescue station' for a mine must be located at
options: Within the prescribed distance from the mine
On the surface near the pit head
questions.solution: Within the prescribed distance from the mine.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Drifting in hard rock requires
options: Drilling and blasting or mechanized methods
questions.solution: Drifting uses drilling/blasting or mechanized methods.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'stenton' in mining refers to
options: A short pillar between two bord pillars
questions.solution: Stenton is a short pillar left between bord pillars.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'rock classification' for drift support decisions is done using
options: Rock mass rating (RMR) or other classification systems
questions.solution: Rock mass rating or other classification systems.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'tone' of an accident report should be
questions.solution: Objective and factual.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'dip and strike' of a seam can be determined using
options: A combination of compass, clinometer, and survey measurements
questions.solution: Combination of compass, clinometer, and survey measurements.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The chain dust sampler is another name for
questions.solution: Chain dust sampler is another name for gravimetric dust sampler.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'compensation for accident' to mine workers is governed by
options: Employees' Compensation Act 1923 and Mines Act 1952
questions.solution: Employees' Compensation Act 1923 and Mines Act 1952.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'rescue equipment maintenance' includes
options: Storing the equipment in a damp shed
Regular servicing, testing, and replacement of components
Using the equipment until it fails
questions.solution: Equipment needs regular servicing, testing, replacement.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A man winding engine and a material winding engine must
options: Be separate unless both are used with safety devices
Be operated by the same person
questions.solution: Separate engines unless both have proper safety devices.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The sirdar must not allow any person to
options: Enter or work in a place he is not authorized
questions.solution: No person shall enter or work in an unauthorized place.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'fire water supply' in mines must be
options: Available only during the rainy season
Adequate, accessible, and connected to fire points
Available only at the shaft bottom
questions.solution: Fire water supply must be adequate and accessible.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The capacity of a belt conveyor depends on
options: Only the length of the belt
The number of idler rollers only
Belt width, speed, and load per unit length
questions.solution: Depends on belt width, speed, and load per unit length.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'safety pillar' during depillaring is left to
questions.solution: Safety pillars protect workers during depillaring operations.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'quality control' in stowing includes
options: Checking slurry consistency, fill density, and pipeline integrity
questions.solution: Checking slurry consistency, fill density, and pipeline integrity.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The dust count method measures
options: The number of dust particles per unit volume of air
questions.solution: Measures number of dust particles per unit volume of air.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'geological fault' can be a source of water inrush because
options: It always shifts the seam upward
It can act as a conduit for groundwater to enter the mine
questions.solution: Acts as a conduit for groundwater to enter the mine.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: For charging and stemming shot-holes, the tools used by the shot-firer shall be:
options: Wooden implements and a scraper of brass or wood
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 197: only wooden implements and a brass or wooden scraper are used, to avoid sparks.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'cross-cut' in mining connects
questions.solution: Cross-cuts connect parallel roadways or workings.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'outcrop' of a coal seam is where
options: Coal seam is exposed at the surface
questions.solution: Outcrop is where the coal seam is exposed at the surface.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Before firing in belowground workings, the shot-firer shall test for inflammable gas within a radius of at least:
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 198: the shot-firer tests the strata and the surrounding area for gas within a radius of 18 m before firing.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A hydraulic excavator is preferred over a rope shovel for
options: Greater flexibility, mobility, and precision in digging
Working on very high benches without support
Higher breakout force in hard rock
Simpler operation on benches above 15 m
questions.solution: Greater flexibility, mobility, and precision in digging.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017, a shot-firer shall not be employed:
options: On any work which makes his earnings depend on the amount of coal produced
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 190: a shot-firer shall not be employed on work dependent on the quantity of coal/mineral produced, to avoid haste.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'fire stopping' must be built using
options: Fire-resistant materials as prescribed by regulations
questions.solution: Fire-resistant materials as prescribed by regulations.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'piezometer' in a mine is used to measure
options: Groundwater pressure or water table level
questions.solution: Measures groundwater pressure or water table level.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'support installation' in a drift must be done
options: After the full drift is driven
As soon as possible after excavation, before the next round
questions.solution: As soon as possible after excavation.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'emergency oxygen supply' for mine rescue must be
options: Sufficient for at least 2 hours of operation
questions.solution: Sufficient for at least 2 hours of operation.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'fire extinguisher inspection' must be done
options: Monthly to ensure it is in working order
questions.solution: Monthly to ensure it is in working order.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'sand stowing' method uses
options: Sand mixed with water to fill the goaf
questions.solution: Sand mixed with water to fill goaf.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The notice of accident under the Mines Act must be given to the inspector within
questions.solution: Within 24 hours.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The man riding system must have a
questions.solution: An emergency braking system is required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Bench stability depends on
options: Only the height of the bench
Only the width of the haul road
Joint orientation, groundwater, weathering, blast damage
questions.solution: Bench stability depends on discontinuities, water, weathering, blasts.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'accident investigation' under the Mines Act is conducted to
options: Find the cause and prevent recurrence
questions.solution: Find the cause and prevent recurrence.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'gradient' of a roadway is calculated from
options: Rise or fall divided by horizontal distance
questions.solution: Gradient is rise/fall divided by horizontal distance.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'water to solids ratio' in hydraulic stowing affects
options: Only the colour of the slurry
Only the height of the dam
Pipeline wear, transport efficiency, and settling
questions.solution: Water/solids ratio affects wear, efficiency, and settling.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'accuracy' of a report is important because
options: Details do not matter in reports
Incorrect information can lead to wrong decisions and safety hazards
questions.solution: Incorrect information can lead to wrong decisions and safety hazards.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'ventilation' of a drift during driving requires
options: The main fan at the surface
Forcing or exhausting system to provide fresh air to the face
Ventilation only after the drift is completed
The same quantity of air as at the shaft bottom
questions.solution: Forcing or exhausting system.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'friction prop' (e.g., Goodman prop) works by
options: Friction between inner and outer tubes under load
questions.solution: Friction props work by friction between nested tubes under load.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'grid system' in mine surveying is used to
options: Establish a coordinate system for reference and mapping
questions.solution: Establishes a coordinate system for reference and mapping.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The maximum number of shots a shot-firer may charge and fire in a shift in a gassy seam (first degree) belowground is:
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 195: 40 shots in gassy seams belowground; 80 shots in other belowground and 100 in opencast workings per shift.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The safety catches in a shaft are designed to
options: Arrest the cage or skip in case of rope failure
questions.solution: Safety catches arrest the cage or skip in case of rope failure.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT a type of man riding system?
questions.solution: Conveyor belts are not used for man riding.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Every mine must conduct regular
questions.solution: Regular safety meetings and toolbox talks are required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'highwall' in opencast mining refers to
options: Unexcavated face of exposed overburden and coal
questions.solution: Highwall is the exposed face of overburden and coal.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'cross-section' in mine surveying shows
options: Transverse view of workings at right angles to alignment
questions.solution: Cross-sections show transverse views of workings.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'depillaring' involves extraction of
options: Pillars left during the development phase
The coal left in the floor
The roof coal in the main roadway
questions.solution: Extraction of pillars from development phase.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'rescue plan' for an emergency must be
options: Prepared, communicated, and known to all rescue team members
questions.solution: Prepared, communicated, and known to all team members.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: In coal mines, the maximum permissible explosive charge per shot is limited to prevent
questions.solution: Charge limits prevent ignition of methane-air mixtures.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The headquarters of UN is in
questions.solution: UN headquarters is in New York.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'contour mining' method is used in
options: Hilly or mountainous terrain along the contour of the hill
questions.solution: Hilly or mountainous terrain along contours.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Which planet is known as the 'Red Planet'?
questions.solution: Mars is called the Red Planet.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Train 150m passes pole in 15 sec. Speed in km/hr?
questions.solution: 10 m/s = 36 km/hr.

questions.stem: If the cost price is ₹800 and the selling price is ₹1000, the profit percentage is

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The HCF of 15, 25, and 35 is
questions.solution: HCF of 15,25,35 is 5.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'Sabarmati Ashram' is located in
questions.solution: Sabarmati Ashram is in Ahmedabad.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Synonym of 'Enormous' is
questions.solution: Enormous means huge.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'Open Cast' method of mining is also known as
questions.solution: Open cast mining is a surface mining method.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'pillar and stall' method in underground mining involves
options: Leaving pillars of coal to support the roof
questions.solution: Leaving pillars to support the roof.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The coal mines in the Coal India Limited (CIL) domain are divided into
questions.solution: CIL domain is divided into 8 coalfield regions.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'first commercial coal mine auction' results showed
options: Competitive bidding and premium over base price
questions.solution: Competitive bidding and premium over base price.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: A bar chart shows sales of 5 products. If product A sales = 100, B = 150, C = 120, D = 80, E = 130, what is the average?

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'electrostatic precipitator' (ESP) in power plants removes
options: Oxides of nitrogen from flue gases
questions.solution: ESPs remove particulate matter from flue gases.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'biodiversity management plan' for mining includes
options: Only the prevention of land subsidence
Conservation of local flora and fauna
Only the management of overburden dumps
Only the control of dust on haul roads
questions.solution: Conservation of local flora and fauna.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The volume of a cylinder with radius 7 cm and height 10 cm is approximately

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Perimeter of square = 48cm. Area?
questions.solution: Side=12. Area=144.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Synonym of 'Verbose' is
questions.solution: Verbose means lengthy.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'coal transportation' from mines primarily uses
questions.solution: Coal transportation primarily uses railways and roads.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'CSR (Corporate Social Responsibility)' activities of CIL are funded from
options: 2% of average net profit as per Companies Act
questions.solution: 2% of average net profit.
